integrity: Proof uses a two-chain linear-extension bijection and exact gap vectors. The attached Python checker independently recomputes finite cases, but finite tests are not a substitute for the proof. No independent mathematical audit or historical-priority certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: The result refutes only the maximizing part of Conjecture 7.1 for two prescribed overlapping occurrences at lengths 2m and overlap m, m >= 4. It neither identifies all maximizers nor treats three or more prescribed occurrences; historical priority is not independently established.
title: Infinite counterexamples to the proposed interleaved maximum for consecutive-pattern packings
